name: TIE Fighter Launches from Ship
description: The TIE Fighter detaches from the larger spacecraft and accelerates rapidly into space.
related_events: TIE Fighter launches from the ship

name: Three TIE Fighters Approach the Massive Ship Above Jakku
description: Three TIE fighters fly through space toward a massive spacecraft orbiting Jakku. They draw closer to the vessel, moving in formation as they near its surface.
related_events: TIE fighters approach massive ship above Jakku

name: Approach to the Star Destroyer
description: Above the sandy planet of Jakku, several Troop Transports and Kylo Ren's Shuttle cut through space, drawing closer to a massive Star Destroyer looming in orbit. The vessels advance steadily, closing the distance as the Star Destroyer's vast hull stretches across the sky.
related_events: Troop Transports and Kylo Ren's Shuttle approach massive STAR DESTROYER

name: FN-2187 Opens Fire
description: FN-2187 raises a weapon and fires it at a target nearby. The sound of gunfire echoes in the immediate environment.
related_events: FN-2187 opens fire

name: Rey Drives Across the Desert at Sunset
description: Rey pilots her speeder across a wide, flat desert beneath an immense setting sun. The vehicle moves swiftly over the barren terrain, casting a long shadow as it cuts through the open expanse. The horizon stretches endlessly, bathed in the red glow of the fading light.
related_events: Rey's speeder races across flat terrain under immense setting sun

name: Rey Crosses the Spaceship Graveyard
description: Rey runs across the desert floor, weaving through the scattered wreckage of crashed spaceships. The remains of the vessels loom around her as she moves quickly, stepping over twisted metal and broken hulls, making her way across the barren and silent field.
related_events: Rey traverses the graveyard of crashed spaceships

name: Laser Blasts Shatter Windows
description: Laser fire strikes the windows, shattering the glass and blowing it inward. The force of the blasts breaks through the barrier, allowing entry into the space.
related_events: Laser blasts shatter windows

name: Scavenger Descends Cable and Lands on Wreck
description: The Scavenger begins the descent down a two-hundred-foot-long cable, moving steadily through the air. The figure drops lower, the wreck growing larger in the dim light. At the end of the cable, the Scavenger lands hard on a rusted metal surface, the impact echoing faintly through the structure.
related_events: Scavenger descends down a two-hundred foot-long cable
Scavenger lands hard on rusty metal surface

name: Poe and FN-2187 Execute Target Strike During Flight
description: Poe flies toward the canons, calling out to the team. Up ahead, he spots the target and confirms their position. We're dead centered, he says. It's a clean shot. FN-2187 acquires the target and fires.
related_events: Poe alerts team to target ahead during flight
FN-2187 acquires target and fires weapon

name: Stormtrooper Retrieves Poe from Cell
description: A stormtrooper enters the cell block and demands custody of Poe. The guard unlocks Poe's restraints. Poe, weakened and in pain, is unshackled and readied for transfer.
related_events: Stormtrooper enters cell block and demands prisoner
Guard unshackles Poe in cell

name: Stormtroopers Lock and Load Before Raid
description: Twenty stormtroopers stand at attention aboard the ship, their movements synchronized with its hum. A filtered command echoes through the chamber. At once, they raise their heavy blaster rifles, locking and loading in unison. The sharp clatter of weapons charging fills the air, then abruptly stops. Silence falls, heavy and still, as the troops hold their position in the quiet before the raid.
related_events: Stormtroopers prepare for raid under filtered command
Sudden quiet follows brutal noise aboard ship

name: Poe and BB-8 Rush Through Village as Villagers Prepare to Defend
description: Poe and BB-8 move quickly through the village, weaving between huts and narrow paths. Around them, villagers clutch weapons and take cover behind walls, barrels, and trees, scanning the horizon. The air is tense as people assume defensive positions, their movements sharp and deliberate. Poe exchanges a brief nod with a villager crouched near a doorway before pressing forward with BB-8 at his side.
related_events: Poe and BB-8 hurry through the village
Armed villagers take defensive positions

name: Stormtrooper Escorts Poe to Narrow Passageway
description: The Stormtrooper leads the handcuffed Poe down a corridor, gripping him firmly. As they walk, the Stormtrooper keeps a blaster pressed against Poe's side. Upon reaching an intersection, the Stormtrooper orders Poe to turn. Poe complies, stepping into a narrow passageway as the Stormtrooper follows closely behind.
related_events: Stormtrooper escorts handcuffed Poe through corridor
Stormtrooper commands Poe to turn into narrow passageway

name: TIE Fighter Launch and Stormtrooper Alert
description: The TIE Fighter lifts off from the hangar bay, tearing free from its charging cables. At the same time, stormtroopers unpack their megablasters and take aim.
related_events: TIE Fighter lifts off from the bay and severs charging cables
Stormtroopers unpack and aim megablasters

name: TIE Fighter Navigates Through Massive Ship
description: The TIE fighter arcs back, dives through the opening between the levels of the massive ship, and flies down along its belly, moving swiftly beneath the vessel's surface.
related_events: TIE fighter arcs back and dives between levels of massive ship
TIE fighter flies along the belly of the massive ship

name: Scavenger Carries Items Across Pipes Toward Sunlight
description: The Scavenger moves across enormous pipes in a vast, dusty space, carrying a satchel and a large found object. Dust drifts through the air as the figure advances steadily toward a distant slit of sunlight cutting through the darkness.
related_events: Scavenger transports satchel and found object across pipes
Scavenger heads toward distant slit of sunlight

name: BB-8 Reacts to a Disturbance and Flees
description: A wide shot shows a small, peaceful village with distant sounds of native animals and a single wind chime. Suddenly, BB-8, a round, skittery droid in orange and white, rises into the frame. He focuses on something beyond the camera and emits rapid, urgent beeps. Moving closer to the camera, his beeping grows faster and more insistent. Then, without warning, he turns and rolls away quickly, vanishing from view.
related_events: BB-8 detects a disturbance and reacts with alarm
BB-8 abruptly turns and rolls away at high speed

name: Stormtroopers Destroy Captured X-wing
description: A Stormtrooper climbs down from the cockpit of Poe's X-wing and steps back, waving an all-clear signal. Three other Stormtroopers raise their laser cannons and open fire on the spacecraft. The X-wing erupts in a large explosion, consuming the ship in flames as debris scatters across the ground.
related_events: Stormtrooper exits Poe's X-wing cockpit and signals clearance
Stormtroopers destroy Poe's X-wing with laser fire

name: Poe Leads Cannon Assault
description: Poe takes the controls of the vehicle, leaning into the motion with a burst of excitement. 'Woooahhh! This thing really moves,' he shouts. His tone sharpens as he scans the battlefield. 'All right, we gotta take out as many cannons as we can or we're not gonna get very far!' He maneuvers the vehicle into position, eyes locked on the targets ahead. 'I'm gonna get us in position, just stay sharp!' FN nods, ready.
related_events: Poe pilots vehicle with excitement and urgency
Poe calls out need to disable cannons
Poe positions vehicle for attack while urging vigilance

name: Poe Endures Interrogation by Kylo Ren
description: Poe wakes up shackled to a chair, his face bruised and lips split from prior beatings. Kylo Ren stands before him, voice calm. He remarks that Poe is the Resistance's best pilot and asks if he is comfortable. Poe, struggling through swollen lips, replies that he is not. Kylo expresses surprise that Poe has not yet revealed the location of the map, despite the methods used. Poe tells him he should rethink his approach. Without speaking again, Kylo reaches a hand toward Poe’s face, stopping short of contact. Poe flinches, then convulses in agony, his body wracked by invisible force. He clenches his teeth, enduring the pain in silence. Kylo demands to know where the map is. Poe, strained but defiant, says the Resistance will not be intimidated. Kylo repeats his question. The pain intensifies. Poe can no longer hold back and begins to scream as the scene cuts away.
related_events: Poe awakens while shackled and beaten
Kylo Ren interrogates Poe about the map
Kylo Ren uses Force-induced torture on Poe
Poe resists interrogation under torture

name: Rey Cleans Salvage Amid Jakku's Daily Routines
description: Rey kneels, scrubbing the metal pieces she collected that day, her hands working steadily over the scrap. She glances up and sees an old woman nearby, bent over her own pile of salvage, cleaning it with slow, practiced motions. Rey watches for a moment, the rhythm of the woman’s work drawing her attention. A small alien underling passes by and barks a short phrase in a foreign language. Rey looks away, then returns to scrubbing the metal in front of her.
related_events: Rey scrubs clean her day's salvage
Rey observes an old woman cleaning salvage
Alien underling communicates with Rey in another language

name: Villagers Defend Against Stormtrooper Attack
description: The transports land in a roar of wind and dust. Stormtroopers pour out, firing blasters. The villagers return fire, shots flashing across the village. Blaster bolts strike several villagers and stormtroopers, sending some falling to the ground.
related_events: Stormtroopers disembark from transports and open fire on villagers
Villagers engage stormtroopers in armed resistance
Several villagers and stormtroopers are hit during the firefight

name: Poe Sees Enemy Ships and Flees with BB-8
description: Poe moves toward the camera and raises his quadnoculars, gazing at lights on the horizon. Enemy ships are approaching. He lowers the device, his eyes wide with tension. The sound of thunder grows louder. Lor San Tekka tells him to go, urging him to leave. Poe turns to him, hesitates for a moment, then nods. He hurries away, with BB-8 rolling quickly behind him.
related_events: Poe observes approaching enemy ships through quadnoculars
Lor San Tekka urges Poe to leave immediately
Poe decides to flee and departs from Lor San Tekka

name: TIE Fighter Destroys Enemy Cannons and Navigates Explosion
description: The TIE Fighter fires lasers at enemy cannons, striking them directly. The impacts trigger a series of violent explosions, sending debris and fire outward. The TIE Fighter continues forward, weaving through the expanding cloud of smoke and shattered remnants as it moves through the battlefield.
related_events: TIE Fighter fires lasers at enemy cannons
Cannons explode from laser impacts
TIE Fighter maneuvers through exploding debris

name: Poe Escorted Through Hangar Under Stormtrooper Guard
description: Poe, his hands bound in shackles, is led from a transport vessel into a vast hangar by a group of Stormtroopers. The guards move swiftly, their pace carrying them past a security checkpoint without delay. As they advance, Poe turns his head, taking in the towering expanse of the hangar, his expression shifting briefly to one of awe.
related_events: Poe is escorted through the hangar while shackled
Poe expresses awe at the hangar's scale
Stormtrooper escort moves quickly past security checkpoint

name: BB-8 Rolls Through Desert After X-Wing Explosion
description: The X-wing erupts in a fireball, lighting the sky. BB-8 rolls across the dark, sandy desert, moving steadily forward. As he travels, he emits a series of high-pitched beeps. A shape stirs in the sand—two red eyes lift into view, watching silently as the droid passes. BB-8 continues on, rolling into the vast, quiet expanse.
related_events: BB-8 rolls across the desert after X-wing explosion
BB-8 emits frightened beeps while traveling alone
Mysterious creature with red eyes observes BB-8 from the sand

name: Rey Hauls Found Objects to Desert Town
description: Rey speeds across the desert toward a dusty settlement. As she nears the town, the sack of scavenged objects on her speeder shifts and tumbles onto the sand. She stops, grabs the heavy sack, and drags it across the ground, pulling it steadily behind her as she continues on foot toward the town.
related_events: Rey's speeder passes by heading toward a desert town
Rey's sack of found objects crashes onto the sand
Rey hauls the sack of found objects toward the town

name: FN-2187 Destroys TIE Fighters and Gun Emplacements
description: FN-2187 opened fire with a series of precise laser blasts, tearing through parked TIE fighters and reducing them to smoldering wreckage. The explosions rippled across the base as he shifted aim, targeting defensive gun emplacements and disabling each with calculated shots. Smoke and debris filled the air as the last emplacement collapsed in a burst of sparks and flame.
related_events: FN-2187 destroys parked TIE fighters with laser blasts
FN-2187 destroys gun emplacements with laser blasts

name: FN-2187 Destroys the Control Room
description: FN-2187 fires a precise laser blast that strikes the control room, damaging the central command and operations center. The explosion spreads through the structure, silencing the systems inside.
related_events: FN-2187 hits the control room with a laser blast

name: Kylo Ren Confronts General Hux About the Droid on Jakku
description: The cell door slid open with a whoosh, and Kylo Ren stepped out, facing General Hux, who stood waiting. 'It's in a droid,' Kylo Ren said. 'A BB unit.' General Hux replied, 'Well then. If it's on Jakku, we'll soon have it.' Kylo Ren looked at him and said, 'I leave that to you.'
related_events: Kylo Ren exits detention cell after door opens
Kylo Ren informs General Hux about BB droid on Jakku
General Hux responds confidently about retrieving the droid
Kylo Ren delegates responsibility to General Hux

name: Rey Trades Salvaged Items for Rations with Unkar Plutt
description: Rey approaches the service window where Unkar Plutt, perched above her behind a protective screen, inspects the items she has brought in. He deliberates briefly, then declares them worth only a quarter portion. Without protest, Rey accepts the offer. Unkar pushes a sealed packet through the transfer drawer—inside, dried green meat rests in one compartment, beige powder in another. She takes the packet, says nothing, and walks away.
related_events: Unkar Plutt evaluates Rey's collected items
Unkar Plutt offers Rey a quarter portion for her items
Rey receives a sealed packet of food from Unkar Plutt
Rey swallows her resentment and leaves the service window

name: Finn's Name and Poe's Introduction
description: After a successful action, FN-2187 shouted in celebration, exclaiming to Poe about what they had just accomplished. Catching his breath, FN-2187 shared his designation, explaining that it was the only name he had ever been given. Poe responded by refusing to use the number, instead offering him a new name: Finn. FN-2187 paused, then smiled, repeating the name and saying he liked it. Poe then introduced himself fully as Poe Dameron. Finn returned the greeting, and the two exchanged mutual recognition, standing together in the aftermath of the moment.
related_events: FN-2187 expresses joy after a successful action
Poe decides to rename FN-2187 as Finn
FN-2187 accepts the name Finn with enthusiasm
Poe introduces himself as Poe Dameron

name: Captain Phasma Confronts FN-2187 in the Dark Vehicle
description: Inside the dark vehicle, FN-2187 removes his helmet. His face is visible for the first time—twenty-three years old, with a look of fear and desperation. Captain Phasma enters behind him. She demands he submit his blaster for inspection and reprimands him for removing his helmet without authorization. She orders him to report to her division immediately. After she leaves, FN-2187, visibly shaken, puts his helmet back on.
related_events: FN-2187 removes his helmet inside the dark vehicle
Captain Phasma confronts FN-2187 about helmet removal
Captain Phasma orders FN-2187 to submit blaster for inspection
Captain Phasma orders FN-2187 to report to her division
FN-2187 puts his helmet back on after confrontation

name: FN-2187 Escorts Poe Through the Hangar to a TIE Fighter
description: FN-2187, his face hidden beneath a stormtrooper's mask, walks through the hangar with Poe, who appears to be a prisoner in his custody. They move steadily through the large space, passing machinery and parked ships. A group of officers approaches from the opposite direction and walks past them. FN-2187 mutters under his breath, 'Okay, stay calm, stay calm.' Poe responds, 'I am calm,' but FN-2187 clarifies, 'I'm talking to myself,' then adds after a pause, 'Not yet. Okay, go. This way.' He leads Poe toward the far wall, up a set of stairs, heading for a two-man Special Forces TIE fighter.
related_events: FN-2187 and Poe walk together through the hangar
Group of officers passes FN-2187 and Poe in the hangar
FN-2187 speaks to himself while approaching the TIE fighter
FN-2187 leads Poe toward a Special Forces TIE fighter

name: Technician Reports Unauthorized Fighter Launch
description: Inside the main control room of a Star Destroyer, a technician watches as a ship struggles to rise from bay two, cables still attached. The technician reports the unsanctioned departure. A First Order Colonel turns sharply and orders for General Hux to be alerted and for the fighter to be stopped.
related_events: Control room technician reports unsanctioned departure
First Order Colonel orders alert and interception

name: Ship Struggles to Ascend with Cables Attached
description: The ship heaves upward, straining against the cables still latched to its hull, as sparks flare from the connections. It lurches in the launch bay, rising unevenly, cables snapping loose one by one. Inside the control room, a technician's voice cuts through the hum of machinery: 'We have an unsanctioned departure from bay two.' A First Order Colonel turns sharply and barks, 'Alert General Hux and stop that fighter.'
related_events: Ship struggles to rise with cables connected

name: Stormtroopers Burn Village and Round Up Villagers
description: Stormtroopers move through the village wielding flame throwers, igniting and destroying buildings. Flames engulf homes as smoke fills the air. Villagers raise their hands and surrender, then are gathered together by the troops. Animals trapped in pens stampede and cry out in panic as the fire spreads.
related_events: Stormtroopers destroy village structures with flame throwers
Villagers are rounded up by stormtroopers
Penned animals panic during the attack

name: Lor San Tekka Walks Through the Burning Village
description: Lor San Tekka moves through the village as stormtroopers ignite buildings with flame throwers. Structures burn, villagers raise their hands and are forced into groups, and penned animals stampede in panic.
related_events: Lor San Tekka moves through the village in sadness

name: Scavenger Retrieves Valuable Component from Inverted Corridor
description: In an upside-down corridor, the Scavenger pries open a metal panel with tools, pulling out various mechanisms from within the wall. Among the debris, a small, valuable component is found and quickly dropped into a satchel. The satchel is swung over a shoulder, and the Scavenger grabs a cable, beginning a descent between jagged walls of machinery.
related_events: Scavenger extracts mechanisms from wall in inverted corridor
Scavenger discovers and collects valuable component

name: Scavenger Descends Through Machinery-Filled Corridor
description: The Scavenger secures the valuable component in the satchel, swings the bag into place, and begins climbing down a cable. Hanging between the tilted walls of a narrow corridor, they move carefully through a dense array of machinery, descending into the depths below.
related_events: Scavenger descends cable through machinery-filled corridor

name: TIE Fighter Evades Warhead Barrage
description: Massive warhead launchers spin and fire blasts toward the TIE fighter. The fighter darts through the air, twisting and turning to avoid the incoming fire. Most of the blasts miss their target, instead exploding against the floating debris left from earlier turbolaser destruction. The TIE fighter then pulls into a sharp turn, heading back toward Jakku, the sandy planet where Poe left BB-8.
related_events: Warhead launchers fire blasts at TIE fighter
TIE fighter performs evasive maneuvers
Blasts strike debris from turbolaser destruction

name: TIE Fighter Breaks Off and Heads Toward Jakku
description: The TIE fighter weaves through the warhead blasts, dodging the explosions that tear through the debris from the turbolaser destruction. After clearing the barrage, it pulls into a wide, sweeping turn and sets a course back toward Jakku, descending toward the desert planet's surface.
related_events: TIE fighter makes sharp turn back toward Jakku

name: Rey Scratches a Mark on the Wall
description: Rey takes a sharp object and scratches a new mark into the rusty wall of her dwelling. The wall is covered with thousands of similar marks. The sound of metal scraping metal echoes faintly. Outside, a dried desert flower sizzles in a rusty engine piece under the heat of the sun. Inside, a handmade doll made from orange flight suit fabric and twine rests on a shelf. Rey moves to a makeshift wok where green meat sizzles over a flame. She opens a packet of powder, pours it into a tin of milky water, and stirs. The mixture expands, forming a loaf. She places the cooked meat on an old plate and picks up the loaf.
related_events: Rey scratches a mark into the rusty wall

name: Rey Cooks and Serves a Meal
description: Rey stands in her dwelling, tending to a makeshift wok where green meat sizzles over heat. She opens a packet of powder and pours it into a tin of milky water, stirring the mixture. The liquid begins to rise and solidify, forming a loaf. She removes the cooked loaf from the tin and sets it aside. With the meat still steaming, she lifts it from the wok and places it onto an old plate. She takes the loaf in her hand, ready to eat.
related_events: Rey cooks green meat in a makeshift wok
Rey mixes powder into water to create a loaf
Rey retrieves the cooked loaf
Rey places sizzling meat onto a plate

name: Lor San Tekka Gives Poe the Sack
description: In a primitive hut, Lor San Tekka places a small leather sack into Poe Dameron's palm. Poe closes his hand around it as the older man covers it with his own. Lor San Tekka says the galaxy has fallen into despair and that without the Jedi, there can be no balance in the Force. He speaks of the General with deep respect, calling her royalty. Poe thanks him, saying they now have a chance. BB-8 enters the hut quickly, beeping in alarm. Poe turns to Lor San Tekka, alert. They have company.
related_events: Lor San Tekka hands a leather sack to Poe Dameron
Lor San Tekka expresses hope for restoring balance in the Force
Lor San Tekka refers to General as royalty

name: BB-8's Warning
description: BB-8 rolls into the hut, beeping urgently. Poe turns sharply, his expression tightening with concern. He looks at Lor San Tekka and says, 'We've got company.'
related_events: BB-8 enters frantically and alerts Poe Dameron
Poe Dameron reacts to BB-8's warning with concern

name: Rey and BB-8 on the Sand
description: BB-8 rolls to a stop on the sand. Rey crouches beside the droid and says the one they’re waiting for might still come. BB-8 emits a questioning beep. Rey looks toward the horizon and says she’s waiting for her family—they’ll return one day. She tries to smile, but it fades. She turns and begins to walk away. BB-8 beeps again, then follows behind her.
related_events: Rey encourages BB-8 not to give up
Rey reveals her hope for her family's return
BB-8 asks a question through beeping
Rey attempts to smile before leaving

name: BB-8 Follows Rey Across the Sand
description: After Rey walks away across the sand, BB-8 lets out a short beep. Then, without further delay, the droid rolls after her, keeping pace as they move together across the desert.
related_events: BB-8 follows Rey across the sand

name: Poe Entrusts the Artifact to BB-8 and Sends the Droid to Safety
description: Poe kneels beneath his X-wing and pulls a small, old artifact from his leather sack. He inserts it into BB-8, whose multi-reader envelops the object. 'You take this,' Poe says. 'It's safer with you than it is with me. You get as far away from here as you can. Do you hear me?' BB-8 beeps and hesitates. 'I'll come back for you! It will be alright,' Poe assures. The droid emits a nervous whine, turns, and rolls away. He stops once to look back at Poe before continuing on. Poe raises his blaster rifle and fires at incoming troopers from cover.
related_events: Poe inserts artifact into BB-8 for safekeeping
Poe instructs BB-8 to flee to safety
BB-8 hesitates and nervously departs

name: Poe Fires on Troopers from Cover
description: After sending BB-8 away, Poe takes position near the X-wing and raises his blaster rifle. He fires at incoming enemy troopers, using the cover of the ship’s wing to shield himself. Blaster bolts flash through the air as he continues to shoot, holding his ground against the advancing soldiers.
related_events: Poe opens fire on incoming troopers from cover

name: FN-2187 Rescues Poe in the Hallway
description: FN-2187, disguised as a Stormtrooper, stops Poe in a narrow hallway. He removes his helmet, revealing his face, and tells Poe he is there to help him escape. Poe, still regaining consciousness, stammers in confusion. FN-2187 asks if Poe can fly a TIE fighter. Poe responds that he can fly anything and questions why FN-2187 is helping him. FN-2187 says it is the right thing to do. Poe realizes FN-2187 needs a pilot. He smiles and agrees to go through with the plan. FN-2187 hesitates, then nods with cautious hope.
related_events: Stormtrooper stops Poe in the narrow hallway
FN-2187 reveals his identity and initiates rescue

name: Poe Proves He Can Fly the TIE Fighter
description: FN-2187 removes his helmet and asks Poe if he can fly a TIE fighter. Poe, regaining consciousness, responds that he can fly anything. FN-2187 repeats that he needs a pilot. Poe understands then that FN-2187 is counting on him to fly them out. He smiles and agrees—they are going to make the escape happen.
related_events: FN-2187 asks Poe if he can pilot a TIE fighter
Poe confirms he can fly any spacecraft
Poe realizes FN-2187 needs a pilot for escape

name: Poe Joins FN-2187's Escape Plan
description: After the Stormtrooper removes his helmet and reveals himself as FN-2187, he tells Poe he is there to rescue him. When FN-2187 asks if Poe can fly a TIE fighter, Poe replies that he can fly anything and demands to know why FN-2187 is helping him. FN-2187 says it is the right thing to do. Poe realizes the offer is genuine and smiles. He agrees to go through with the escape, saying, 'We're gonna do this.' FN-2187, uncertain but hopeful, responds, 'Yeah?'
related_events: Poe agrees to cooperate in the escape plan

name: Rey Emerges from the Darkness
description: Rey steps out of the shadows, pulling off her goggles and gear, revealing a young woman's grimy face. She uncaps a canteen and shakes out the last two drops of water into her mouth, then strikes the container against her palm, trying to extract anything left. She places her belongings on a sheet of metal, sits beside them, and slides down a sand dune, riding a growing pile of sand toward the distant salt flats. Behind her, the massive remains of a crashed Star Destroyer loom. Ahead, her speeder waits. She reaches it, climbs on, and starts the sputtering engine before driving across the barren landscape.
related_events: Rey arrives from the darkness and removes scavenging gear

name: Rey Drinks the Last of Her Water
description: Rey pulls off her goggles and gear, revealing her grimy face. She opens her canteen and shakes out the last two drops of water into her mouth. She hits the side of the canteen repeatedly, trying to get any remaining moisture. After setting her things on a piece of sheet metal, she slides down the sand dune, riding the mountain of sand toward the distant salt flats. Scattered debris lies around her as she reaches her speeder, climbs on, starts the sputtering engine, and drives off.
related_events: Rey consumes the last drops of water from her canteen
Rey attempts to extract residual water by hitting her canteen

name: Rey Rides Down the Sand Dune
description: Rey sets her belongings on a piece of sheet metal and sits beside them at the edge of a sand dune. She slides down the slope, riding the sheet as it carries her down the mountain of sand. The wreckage of the Star Destroyer looms behind her, growing more distant with each passing moment. Below, the salt flats stretch wide and empty, and her speeder waits, a small shape against the vast landscape.
related_events: Rey slides down the sand dune and rides down the mountain of sand

name: Rey Drives Off on Her Speeder
description: Rey approaches her junker speeder, climbs onto it, and starts the sputtering engine. The machine coughs to life, and she drives off across the sandy terrain, disappearing into the distance.
related_events: Rey approaches her speeder and starts the engine
Rey drives off on her speeder

name: FN-2187 and Poe Prepare the TIE Fighter for Flight
description: FN-2187 and Poe climb into the cockpit of the TIE fighter. FN-2187 takes off his helmet while Poe removes his cuffs and jacket. Poe activates the ship’s systems, bringing the TIE fighter to life as the engines power up.
related_events: FN-2187 and Poe enter the TIE fighter cockpit
FN-2187 removes his helmet
Poe removes his cuffs and jacket
Poe powers up the TIE fighter

name: Poe Teaches FN-2187 to Operate the TIE Fighter's Weapons
description: Poe and FN-2187 climb into the cockpit of a TIE fighter. Poe removes his jacket and cuffs, then starts the ship. He tells FN-2187 he’s always wanted to fly one. When Poe asks if FN-2187 can shoot, FN-2187 says he can handle blasters. Poe explains the controls: use the toggle on the left to switch between missiles, cannons, and mag pulse, the sight on the right to aim, and the triggers to fire. FN-2187 finds the system complicated as the TIE fighter lurches forward. Poe says he can fix it.
related_events: Poe explains weapon controls to FN-2187
FN-2187 expresses difficulty with controls

name: Poe Stabilizes the Out-of-Control TIE Fighter
description: The TIE fighter surged forward suddenly as soon as it powered up, jerking violently. Poe winced, bracing himself in the cockpit. "I can fix this," he said, gripping the controls and working quickly to steady the ship.
related_events: TIE fighter lurches forward abruptly
Poe attempts to stabilize the TIE fighter

name: Rey Negotiates for Fair Trade
description: Rey stands at Unkar Plutt's window with her collected scavenged items. Unkar inspects the goods and offers her one half portion for all five pieces. Rey objects, pointing out that last week each piece was worth a half portion. Unkar leans forward, his tone shifting as he looks at BB-8. He asks Rey about the droid, then offers sixty portions for it. Rey hesitates, visibly stunned by the amount. BB-8 beeps urgently, clearly uncomfortable. Rey looks from Unkar to the droid, then shakes her head. She tells Unkar the droid is not for sale and walks away, BB-8 following closely behind.
related_events: Unkar Plutt evaluates Rey's collected goods
Unkar Plutt offers reduced payment for Rey's goods
Rey objects to the reduced trade value

name: Rey Refuses Unkar's Offer for BB-8
description: Rey stands with BB-8 in front of Unkar Plutt at his trading window. After inspecting the items she brought, Unkar offers one half portion for all five. Rey objects, reminding him they were worth a half portion each the previous week. Unkar leans forward and asks about the droid. Rey hesitates, then asks what about him. Unkar offers sixty portions for BB-8. Rey is stunned, her hunger evident as her stomach seems to rumble at the thought of so much food. BB-8 beeps urgently, clearly uneasy. Rey looks from Unkar to the droid, then back again. After a pause, she says the droid is not for sale and tells BB-8 to come along. Unkar grows furious as they turn and leave. He watches them go, then picks up a communicator and orders someone to follow the girl and take the droid. He slams the service window shut.

description: Poe sprints toward an X-Wing fighter hidden behind a rock outcropping. He signals BB-8, who rolls quickly into the droid socket. Poe climbs into the cockpit as the controls light up around him. The canopy seals shut. Outside, landing lights flicker on and the engines begin to whine. Poe glances back—the enemy is approaching in the distance. He works the controls urgently. BB-8 lets out a short beep.

description: The enemy struck the base, destroying the turbolasers. Lieutenant Mitaka turned to General Hux and reported the damage. Hux immediately ordered the ventral cannons activated. Mitaka confirmed the command and began bringing the cannons online. Around them, the command center erupted into motion as personnel worked quickly to respond to the attack. Alarms flashed and voices overlapped as systems were reconfigured. Soon, Mitaka reported back: the ventral cannons were hot and ready. Hux gave the final order—'Fire.'

name: Rey Hears a Distress Call and Rescues BB-8
description: Rey sits alone on the leg of a fallen AT-AT, eating hungrily from a metal plate and licking it clean. She picks up a broken Rebellion helmet and places it on her head, gazing out at the distant horizon where a single ship trails a thin contrail across the sky. Suddenly, an electronic squeal cuts through the silence. She rips the helmet off, grabs her quarterstaff, and sprints across the sand. She climbs a dune and sees BB-8 tangled in a net, struggling as a Teedo on a luggabeast yells over him. Rey shouts in protest. The Teedo turns, argues back, but she advances, draws a knife, and cuts BB-8 free. When the Teedo shouts in anger, she snaps at him, 'Noma,' and he rides away. BB-8 beeps defiantly after him until Rey hushes him. She kneels, straightens his bent antenna, and asks where he comes from. He beeps a response. 'Classified. Really? Me too,' she says. She points toward Niima Outpost and warns him about Kelvin Ridge and the Sinking Fields. As she walks away, BB-8 follows. She stops, turns, and tells him not to come. He beeps again, plaintively. She hesitates, then gestures for him to follow. Together, they walk off behind a dune.

name: Rey Rescues BB-8 from the Teedo
description: Rey watches from a dune as a Teedo yells at BB-8, who is caught in a net and struggling. She calls out sharply, stopping both the Teedo and the droid. The Teedo shouts back, defiant, but Rey moves forward, draws a knife, and begins cutting BB-8 free. The Teedo protests, agitated, but Rey turns and commands him fiercely. He lets out a furious cry, then rides away on his Luggabeast. BB-8 beeps loudly after him, but Rey hushes him. She kneels, notices his bent antenna, and straightens it. She tells him Niima Outpost is that way, warns him about Kelvin Ridge and the Sinking Fields, then walks off. BB-8 follows, and though she tells him not to, he persists. After a soft, plaintive beep, she stops, looks back, and gestures reluctantly for him to come. He joins her, and they walk together over the dune.

She kneels beside him, straightens his bent antenna, and tells him the Teedo wanted him for parts. When BB-8 beeps a question, she answers, 'That's just Teedo. Wants you for parts. He has no respect for anyone. Your antenna's bent.' She points toward the horizon. 'Niima Outpost is that way, stay off Kelvin Ridge. Keep away from the Sinking Fields in the north, you'll drown in the sand.' As she turns to leave, BB-8 follows. She stops, turns, and tells him not to come along. He beeps again, softer this time. She hesitates, then gestures for him to follow. They walk together behind a dune.

description: Kylo Ren emerges from a descending shuttle, stepping onto the battlefield amid smoke and wind. He walks steadily through the chaos, approaching Lor San Tekka, who stands defiant. The two face each other, Kylo Ren towering over the elder. Kylo demands the location of the map to Luke Skywalker. San Tekka refuses, speaking of Kylo's past and his connection to a lineage that once stood against the dark. As the confrontation ends, Kylo ignites his lightsaber and strikes San Tekka down.

name: Kylo Ren Kills Lor San Tekka and Captures Poe Dameron
description: Kylo Ren ignited his lightsaber, its red-yellow blades crackling with energy, and brought it down on Lor San Tekka, killing him. Poe Dameron broke from cover, sprinting forward and firing his blaster. The bolt froze in midair as Kylo Ren raised his hand, halting Poe in place with the Force. Stormtroopers rushed forward, seized Poe, and dragged him past the suspended blaster fire to where Kylo Ren stood. They forced him to his knees. Kylo Ren knelt slightly, studied him, then ordered the troopers to search him. After finding nothing, he commanded, 'Put him on board.'

name: Kylo Ren Interrogates Poe and Takes Him Aboard
description: Kylo Ren strides toward Poe Dameron, who is held by stormtroopers. He demands the map to Skywalker, his voice cold and commanding. At his order, the troopers search Poe thoroughly, turning his gear over and checking his person, but find nothing. Kylo Ren kneels in front of Poe, studying him in silence. Poe, still defiant, mocks the mask and asks who will speak first. Without reply, Kylo stands and commands, 'Put him on board.' Two troopers grab Poe and drag him toward the open hatch of the shuttle craft, where the interior lights glow dimly against the smoke and wind. Poe resists, but is forced inside. The shuttle remains grounded, its ramp still lowered, as the troopers step back.

Phasma relays the order, and the troopers raise their blasters. As the others open fire, Our Trooper remains still, his weapon lowered, while blasterfire erupts around him.
